integrity: Proof reconstructs positive-definite Gram invariants and exhibits an explicit nonisometric two-moment collision; standalone exact rational checker passed 62 nondegenerate cases, but finite tests are not the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only two independent area-uniform points in a nondegenerate Euclidean parallelogram; exact population moments, no noisy finite-sample stability or general quadrilateral rigidity. Historic priority provisional, notably because Gates (1982) full text and the later part of Tong et al. (2013) were not accessible. Sheng (1985) establishes general forward parallelogram distance moments; full text was inaccessible and may implicitly or explicitly contain the inverse claim, a significant priority uncertainty.
title: Three even pair-distance moments reconstruct a parallelogram, sharply
